intro: Press play to watch one bank reconciliation, from your request to the sign-off.
end: The run is complete. You hold the sign-off, and the agent changed nothing in your books. It can save your settings for next time, but only after you say yes.

steps.title: Ask for a bank reconciliation
steps.say: You name the account and the month, or the agent asks for them.

steps.title: Ask six questions in one message
steps.say: The agent asks about the source, the account, the period, the statement, the last reconciliation and the amount worth chasing.
steps.guard: The agent never assumes the period.

steps.title: Answer the questions
steps.say: One reply answers all six questions, so the run does not stop again for each one.

steps.title: Connected to MosoFin, and you chose it?
steps.say: Your answer sets how the agent gets your books: it reads them directly, or you upload files.

steps.title: Check workspace, company file and tools
steps.say: The agent confirms the workspace and the company file by name. It checks for a bank feed.
steps.guard: The agent uses read-only tools. Tools that write to your books are out of scope.

steps.title: Upload the statement and ledger
steps.say: You upload the bank statement, the ledger cash activity and the last reconciliation or its date.

steps.title: Approve the plan
steps.say: The agent reads the plan back to you and waits.
steps.guard: The agent reads nothing until you say yes.

steps.title: Read the books in one batch
steps.say: The agent reads accounts, the trial balance, the general ledger, deposits, payments, transfers and journal entries.

steps.title: Read your uploaded files
steps.say: The agent reads the statement and the ledger activity that you uploaded.

steps.title: Agree the opening balance
steps.say: The agent records both ending balances, agrees the opening balance and brings last period's open items forward.
steps.guard: With no statement balance, the agent prepares the book side only and builds no bridge.

steps.title: Match transactions and build the bridge
steps.say: Open items from last period match first. Then the agent tries exact, fuzzy, reference and split matches, and finds duplicates in the books.

steps.title: Sort what is left unmatched
steps.say: The agent sorts fees, interest, returned payments, loans, reserves and chargebacks. An unknown item stays unknown and gets an owner.

steps.title: Propose entries with evidence
steps.say: Each proposed entry uses your account names and points to its evidence: a statement line or ledger rows.
steps.guard: The agent proposes entries only. It never posts them.

steps.title: Review and sign off
steps.say: You get a summary, the open items, the exceptions, the proposed entries and a blank sign-off for two people.
